requirements.title: Declaration-derived deployment closure with reasons and digest
requirements.description: The transitive closure of scenarios, resources, tools, safeguards and credential descriptors derives from component declarations and the analyzer with an inclusion reason per component; missing catalog data yields unavailable readiness, not an empty closure.

validation.notes: Transitive closure with a reason per edge, scenario dependency owning its own resource and credential, missing catalog data as closure_unavailable, analyzer outage as closure_unavailable, optional selection rules, repository scope system_required.
Real repository catalog through repo-contract and packages/hostreq; no product-name rule.
Manifest dependencies/bundle are the closure projection and carry closure_digest; closure failure refuses the refresh.
GET /closure and POST /closure/explain return the identical closure document; typed errors pass through.

requirements.title: Unsupported platform and capability explanations
requirements.description: Resources lacking an artifact for the target architecture, dependency cycles and contradictory operating modes produce typed unsupported results naming the dependency.

validation.notes: missing_platform_artifact names the dependency for an absent arm64 artifact; unsupported_platform and unsupported_control_plane_platform; required-edge cycle is closure_cycle with the path, optional cycle resolves; one_shot+auto_restart and disallowed provider mode are closure_conflict; insufficient_capacity including transient update headroom.
Unsupported list and typed closure_cycle/closure_unavailable over HTTP.

requirements.title: Machine configuration through setup/v1 selection and onboarding handoff
requirements.description: Cloud supplies configuration through the shared selection contract and resumable onboarding handoff; supervision membership and auto-restart remain independent controls.

validation.notes: ToSelection parity: identical Selection bytes for the same closure; Selection and closure cover exactly the same configurable components; explicit field presence.
Supervision membership and auto-restart carried and overridden independently (TestSupervisionAndAutoRestartAreIndependent).

requirements.title: Shared reach through Bridge and nodereach
requirements.description: Enrolled machines are resolved through shared target resolution; typed target-local actions are dispatched with grant checks; revoked enrollment never falls back to private transport.

validation.notes: [REQ:STC-P0-024] typed argv validation, explicit transport without fallback, revocation refused before any transport call
argv-only quoting policy, stdin never in the command string, exit-code classification
operation worker receipt reads go through reach

requirements.title: Host repair delegated to control-plane owners
requirements.description: Cloud contains no private apt, firewall, prune or process-kill implementations; repairs are declared control-plane actions scoped to owned workloads.

validation.notes: The contract requires host detection and remediation to remain with control-plane owners. Certification remains pending until the managed target-owner repair path is exercised with privilege denial, scoped cleanup and multi-workload isolation evidence.
